note: Comment protection rules, consumed by comment-fingerprint.mjs and by any comment codemod. FROZEN means byte-identical text AND an unchanged anchor. KEEP means the information must survive somewhere in the file's comments; rewording is allowed. A repo adds its own under `protectedComments` in its .claude/workflow.json.

frozen.name: tool directives
frozen.reason: Each one changes what a compiler, linter, formatter or bundler does. Deleting one is silent: SahajAtlasWeb/src/mocks/regions.ts holds 12 region literals on one line each behind 27 trailing prettier-ignores, and the next format run would explode the file.

frozen.name: legal
frozen.reason: Removing a licence notice is a licensing question, never a tidying one.

frozen.name: WordPress plugin header
frozen.pattern: ^\s*\*?\s*(Plugin Name|Plugin URI|Description|Version|Requires at least|Requires PHP|Author|Author URI|License|License URI|Text Domain|Update URI)\s*:
frozen.reason: WordPress core parses this block to register the plugin. It looks exactly like a bloated file header to a generic tool.

frozen.name: PHPCS and WordPress conventions
frozen.reason: WordPress Coding Standards requires the @package tag on every file header.

frozen.name: i18n translator context
frozen.reason: WP-CLI's i18n extractor reads the comment IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING a gettext call and ships it into the .pot. SahajAtlasWordpress carries 34 .po/.mo pairs. Delete one of the 9, or insert anything between it and its call, and translator context drops for 34 locales. Nothing in that repo lints it — pnpm lint is a token_get_all syntax check.

keep.name: explicit load-bearing marker
keep.reason: These repos already mark their own load-bearing constraints with the warning sign. 362 of them. It is the highest-confidence do-not-delete signal in the corpus, written by the people who paid for each one.

keep.name: cross-repo sync pointer
keep.reason: Nothing enforces the couplings between these five repos except prose. SahajAtlasWeb#170 — that giving <sahaj-atlas> a height is the opt-in for a contained map — lives in four files across three repos, one of them a CSS comment with no type system behind it. Deleting one side leaves the other describing a contract nobody holds.

keep.name: issue breadcrumb
keep.reason: A GitHub issue is immutable and carries the evidence a compressed comment cannot. This over-matches CSS hex colours; that costs nothing, because protection is fail-safe by design. Do not tune it.

keep.name: cross-file path reference
keep.reason: A pointer to the file that holds the other half of an invariant.

keep.name: Ladle story description
keep.reason: Ladle renders a story's leading JSDoc as its description in the component explorer. Collapsing it is not a test failure, so nothing catches it — it is a silent docs-UI regression in SahajAtlasWeb and WeMeditateWeb.

denyPaths.reason: The plugin header block WordPress core parses. Never sweep it.
Third-party source. vendor/plugin-update-checker alone is 42 committed PHP files.
Vendored third-party shapes, not our prose.

textGuards.name: de-branding check
textGuards.reason: SahajAtlasWeb/src/lib/brand.test.ts reads the RAW TEXT of these seven files, comments included, and fails if a visitor-facing brand name appears (#156). It has already fired once on a comment that got reflowed onto one line (PR #197). Check proposed comment text against this before writing. Hyphenated sahaj-atlas is safe; the spaced form is not.
